name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 2px #005fcc focus ring with a 1px #fff inset at 70% opacity. It meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while keeping the ring thin enough to avoid obscuring nearby UI elements on mobile or small screens. The trade-off is slightly reduced contrast against dark backgrounds, but the white inset maintains legibility.

name: Reader
text: The 2px #005fcc ring with white inset fails WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds (#000000) where contrast drops below 4.5:1. Use a 3px #ffffff ring with 20% opacity instead—it meets AA on all backgrounds and remains visible at 12px touch targets. Test it on actual device screens in both light/dark modes to confirm.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #ffffff focus ring with 20% opacity. It meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on both light and dark backgrounds while remaining visible at 12px touch targets. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring that may feel heavier on small or dense interfaces, but it guarantees accessibility for all users without exceptions. Test it on real devices in both modes before finalizing.

name: Reader
text: The 3px white ring risks blending into light backgrounds where it loses visibility entirely. A 2px #ffffff ring at 80% opacity meets WCAG 2.2 AA on dark backgrounds and remains visible on light ones—test it on actual device screens in both modes to confirm.
